Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office issues Bid #E20P4600040 for 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops with extended 3-year warranty and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Docks (WD22TB4), with specifications including Intel Core Ultra 5 125U processor, 16GB DDR5 RAM, 256GB SSD, 15.6" FHD display, Windows 11 Pro, and ENERGY STAR/EPEAT Gold certification. Bids are due by 06/10/2024 at 2:00 PM EDT via electronic submission through the State's eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) e-Procurement system, with delivery within 45 days of award. Dell manufacturer authorization and Mercury Affidavit are required; additional warranty certificate or affidavit must be presented upon award. The bid uses the Desktop, Laptop and Tablet 2015 Master Contract (060B5400007).
